seo.metaTitle: Regex tester & explainer — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Test regular expressions with live match counts, captured groups, and character positions. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/regex-tester-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Regex tester & explainer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/regex-tester-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Regex tester & explainer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Regex tester & explainer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/regex-tester-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Regex tester & explainer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/regex_tester.json or open /tools/regex-tester?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
